incident: A proposed full-file publication retained installation-specific metadata in a source note despite its link-only editorial change. The operation was denied before any commit or ref update.
response: Stopped the original payload, reviewed every changed full file for environment-identity categories, and prepared explicit public derivatives preserving technical observations, failures, provenance limits and fixed source references. No alternate publication route used.
limitations: Pattern scans alone missed contextual installation data; acceptance requires semantic review of complete payloads. This correction does not certify all historical archives or erase Git history.
